testSteps.description: Excel upload offers a sample for each catalogued Excel bank #1 - bank_code: KUVEYT_TURK, bank_name: Kuveyt Türk Katılım Bankası

children.description: Given the supported-bank catalogue contains bank "KUVEYT_TURK" with format "EXCEL"
And the manager opens Excel / statement upload
When the sample workbook options are displayed
Then a downloadable sample workbook is shown for "Kuveyt Türk Katılım Bankası"
And the downloaded workbook is a valid Excel file with fictional transaction rows
And uploading the sample does not settle or mutate real dues
